==Obtaining==
After completing a game of [[Fishing Trawler]], pieces of the outfit may be found in the trawler net directly west of the boat. Players have a 1/12 chance{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/fishing-trawler-improvements-and-equipment-rebalance-part-one?oldschool=1|title=Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One|newsdate=21 April 2021}} of receiving a piece of the outfit that they do not currently own. The contribution bar must be at or above 50 when the game ends for a chance to receive a piece of the outfit.

It may also be obtained from [[aerial fishing]], by purchasing it from [[Alry the Angler]] for a price of 100 [[Molch pearl]]s per piece.

=== Spirit angler ===
{{Main|Spirit angler's outfit}}
Players can upgrade to the [[spirit angler's outfit]] by exchanging the equivalent piece of angler's outfit, along with 1,200 [[spirit flakes]] for each piece (4,800 total), to [[Gita Prymes]] in the [[Ruins of Unkah]]. The spirit version offers a new look, and allows players to use the outfit as a rope to tether to objects when fighting [[Tempoross]].

=== Time investment ===
The potential experience saved getting to 99 in the Fishing skill is not necessarily worth spending the time to get the set. Since it costs 400 [[Molch pearls]] for the full set, [[aerial fishing]] is '''not recommended''' for obtaining the outfit, as it may take well over 20 hours to complete the set, making [[Fishing Trawler]] the most efficient option.

With each piece obtained independently at a rate of 1 in 12, the expected number of Fishing Trawler games required to obtain the full outfit is 48. Given that each game takes five minutes, with 1 minute queue time between games, it will take 4 hours and 48 minutes on average to complete the set, assuming that no games are lost. 

If players have obtained the full set at level 34, the level needed to equip it, they will need 13,014,207 experience to reach level 99. During this training, 317,420 bonus experience will be earned by the time players reach level 99, leaving 12,696,787 Fishing experience earned through regular training methods. By these numbers, every hour spent obtaining the outfit will only be more efficient if players earn '''66,129''' experience an hour or less.

Anyone who isn't planning to use the above methods to 99 will benefit from obtaining the outfit before training. Keep in mind too that there is a combat task, a clue step, and minnow fishing that require the outfit as well, regardless of the experience bonus it offers.
